name: Yamamura Misa Suspense: Kyoto Ryuu no Tera Satsujin Jiken
original_name: 山村美紗サスペンス 京都龍の寺殺人事件
source: The protagonist is American investigator Catherine Turner, who has just been accused of a crime commited in the grounds of Kyoto's most famous temple. She'll have to do some detective work to clear her name.
translation: 主人公是美国调查员凯瑟琳·特纳，刚刚被指控在京都最著名寺庙内犯下罪行。她必须展开调查，证明自己的清白。
